about.expanding: We dey expand — hold on small.
about.heroBody: Reallow na where you fit rent, buy or sell house direct — we don confirm who everybody be for both side, we go check the house with our eye before e show, and you go see clear price before you agree. Na to make am easy we dey find: less running up and down, less surprise, and you go quick reach house wey you fit enter.
about.heroTitle: To find house no suppose be like second work.
about.howTitle: From searching reach moving in, everything for one place.
about.ownersBody: Reallow dey check every person wey apply, dey answer every question, and dey arrange every inspection for you, so na only people wey ready to move you go hear from — whether you dey rent out or you dey sell.
about.ownersTitle: Serious people, quick quick — without you running around.

about.readyBody: Check houses wey we don confirm, or put your house make you meet serious people wey we don check.
about.readyTitle: You ready to see am by yourself?
about.step1.body: Check houses wey we don confirm for Abuja, Port Harcourt and Warri, with full breakdown of money from the start — rent or price, caution fee, estate charge, Reallow service charge. No hidden money later.
about.step1.title: Search and compare
about.step2.body: Show say you like one house and the owner go check you direct. If dem agree, you go move to next step — no wasted trip.
about.step2.title: Apply make dem accept you
about.step3.body: Book inspection wey you go pay for, price depend on location, and one of our agents go show you the real house with your eye before you agree anything.
about.step3.title: Go see am with your eye
about.step4.body: Sign the tenancy agreement or sale paper and pay through Reallow — all the money dey enter one safe account, with receipt for every kobo.
about.step4.title: Sign and close am
about.tenantsBody: No guessing how much you go pay, no going to see house wey no be the person own. We don check every house and explain the money before you pay one naira.
about.tenantsEyebrow: For people wey dey rent and buy
about.tenantsTitle: See the real cost, see the real house, before you agree.
about.value1.body: We don confirm who get every account, and Reallow agent don go check every house with eye before e show.
about.value1.title: We don check am, no be just to list am
about.value2.body: We dey show every cost before you pay anything — rent or price, caution fee, estate charge, Reallow service charge. Wetin we tell you na wetin you go pay.
about.value2.title: Clear price
about.value3.body: Reallow dey arrange every question, inspection and signing for you, so finding, renting, buying or selling house no go be like part-time work again.
about.value3.title: Easy from start to finish
about.valuesTitle: Na trust wey you fit check we build am on, no be blind trust.
about.verifiedNote: We don check every house with our eye before e show
about.whereBody: Every account, house and inspection for Reallow today dey for one of these three cities — na on purpose, so we fit really check wetin we talk say we check, face to face, instead of spreading go places we never fit reach.
about.whereTitle: Reallow dey work for Abuja, Port Harcourt and Warri for now.
about.why1: Plenty of am still depend on who you know, and whether the person wey dey show you house dey talk true about who get am. Reallow dey here to change that wahala with something you fit check: people wey we don confirm, inspection with eye before house show, and record for every money wey you pay.
about.why2: Reallow dey handle the parts wey dey give wahala — to check every account and every house, to arrange every question and inspection so nothing go miss, to write the papers, and to collect money for one place with clear breakdown before anybody agree.
about.whyTitle: Renting and buying house for Naija dey depend on trust wey hard to check.

faq.account1.a: To verify your NIN or driver's licence dey make sure say everybody for Reallow na real person. You need am to apply for house, book inspection, or make your house show for di site.
faq.account1.q: Why I need to verify who I be?
faq.account2.a: Open di profile menu, then Settings. Contact na where your email and phone numbers dey; Security na where you go change your password.
faq.account2.q: How I go change my email, phone or password?
faq.account3.a: Every profile detail get im own “Other people fit see am” switch, wey dey off from start. We no dey ever show your phone, email, address, birthday or bank details to other people.
faq.account3.q: Who fit see my profile details?
faq.inspections1.a: Once di landlord accept your application, open Meetings for your dashboard, choose “Book inspection”, pick one day for di calendar and time. Di landlord fit accept, decline, or suggest another time.
faq.inspections2.a: Inspection fee depend on where di house dey and e cover di Reallow agent wey go follow you. You go pay am once una agree time — from your Reallow wallet or with card.
faq.inspections3.a: Inspection na visit to di house wey you pay for, with Reallow agent dey there. Meeting na free appointment between you and di other side, wey Reallow arrange.
faq.inspections3.q: Wetin be di difference between inspection and meeting?
faq.inspections4.a: After di day pass, open Meetings and press “Rate dis visit” to give stars and comment (like say di agent late). Na only Reallow go see am. If e urgent, contact us straight.
faq.inspections4.q: Something no go well for my inspection — wetin I go do?
faq.listing1.a: From your dashboard choose “List house”, fill di details and full address, check di cost breakdown, then confirm. To list na free.
faq.listing1.q: How I go list my house?
faq.listing2.a: We dey check every house face-to-face before e go live. Reallow agent go call you to arrange visit; you go get notification and email to confirm di time. Dem must still verify your own ID too.
faq.listing2.q: Why my house never show for di site?
faq.listing3.a: You go collect di full rent plus caution fee and estate charge if e dey — or di full sale price. Na di tenant or buyer dey pay Reallow service charge on top, we no dey remove am from your money.
faq.listing3.q: How much di landlord or seller go collect?
faq.payments1.a: You fit put money for your wallet with card and use am pay inspection fee and other payments — we go always ask you before we pay from am. Referral money dey enter there too once dem approve am.
faq.payments2.a: Open Wallet for your dashboard and request withdrawal (at least ₦3,000). First add your bank details for Settings — di account name must match di ID wey dem verify.
faq.payments2.q: How I go withdraw from my wallet?
faq.payments3.a: Reallow dey hold di money and go pay di landlord after di rent or sale don complete and dem don hand over di house.
faq.referrals1.a: Share your referral code (e dey your dashboard). When person sign up with am and finish deal for Reallow, you go get percentage of di sale, wey go enter your wallet after Reallow approve am.
faq.renting1.a: Open di house and press “Apply for dis house” (or “Save for later” to come back). You need verified ID (NIN or driver's licence) to apply. Di landlord go see wetin you choose to share for your profile and accept or decline — we go tell you either way.
faq.renting1.q: How I go apply for house?
faq.renting2.a: Every house dey show full breakdown before you pay: rent (or sale price), caution fee and estate charge if e dey, plus Reallow service charge — 10% of one year rent for rent, 5% of di price for sale. No other fee dey.
faq.renting2.q: How much I go pay altogether?
faq.renting3.a: No. Every payment dey enter Reallow account, and na Reallow dey pay di landlord. No ever send money to anybody outside Reallow for house wey dey here.
faq.renting3.q: I go ever pay di landlord direct?
faq.renting4.a: No — for everybody safety, users no dey see each other phone number or email and dem no fit message each other. Na Reallow dey arrange every inspection and meeting, and na only Reallow go contact you direct.
faq.renting4.q: I fit contact di landlord (or di person wey apply) direct?
faq.renting5.a: Dem dey pay di caution fee to di landlord together with di rent — Reallow no dey hold am. Any refund for di end of your rent na between you and your landlord based on una agreement.
faq.report1.a: Use di “Report” link for di house or profile page. Reallow dey check every report. If person tell you make you pay outside Reallow, report am sharp-sharp.
faq.report1.q: How I go report house or person?
